## Description

A suctorian: a sphere of ~35 µm on a stalk, without cilia as an adult. Its capitate tentacles stick
to passing ciliates and suck out their cytoplasm.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 2 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

[Tentacle feeding](../../mechanics/feeding-and-phagocytosis.md) (`Captured`) on a thin, refringent rigid stalk
secreted by the scopula (width estimated).
